create_random_maze: create a RandomMaze instance with default height and width of 11x11
create_random_maze_custom: create a RandomMaze with custom height, width, max_rooms, and room size parameters
create_random_maze_seeded: create a RandomMaze with a fixed random_seed for reproducible maze generation
create_random_maze_doors: create a RandomMaze with has_doors enabled and extra_connection_probability set
regenerate_random_maze: regenerate a RandomMaze instance to produce a new random layout
